intro: Tome of Divinity is a rite of passage quest offered to young dwarven paladins serving in Dun Morogh. Directed by Brandur Ironhammer, the paladin trainer in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries, an initiate is sent upstairs to speak with the respected paladin trainer Tiza Battleforge. It marks the transition from basic martial training into the deeper spiritual duties and sacred vows of the Holy Light.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, friend. I know you're busy helping out the people of Dun Morogh, but when you have the time, you should go upstairs and speak to one of our most respected ilk: Tiza Battleforge. She's the one the younger paladins go to when it's time they learn more about the Light and what's expected of ya.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well met, friend. I hope the Light shows you the true path and keeps you safe from evil.
